about: Recorded reasons for a quality metric that got worse than quality/baseline.json (spec §12). Each entry covers one change: the metric, its baseline value (from), the value it may reach or anything better (to), why, and the day. Without an entry, scripts/quality-check.mjs fails the release. When the baseline is re-measured, entries for the old values simply stop applying.

accepted.reason: the layout runs in a Web Worker (spec §9 layout_contained); the worker's own copy of the layout-source code is the cost of containing it
